newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends firmer ahead of Easter holiday.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends firmer ahead of Easter holiday.

text.p: COMEX copper ended firmer after a narrowly traded session in light volume ahead of the Easter Holiday weekend.
COMEX and LME are closed Good Friday, with LME also closed Easter Monday.
"There was some shortcovering and profit-taking, but the market is still trending higher," Bette Raptopoulos of Prudential Securities said.
"There is continued expectation of a draw down in LME stocks," she added.
May COMEX settled 1.30 cents firmer at 111.95 cents per pound, traded 112.20 to 111.20.
Spot April went out 1.10 cents firmer at 112.75 cents.
Volume was estimated at 7,000 lots compared with Wednesday's official 17,645 lots.
